title: Skinwalker Ranch camera dismantled between frames

tellings.quote: And in that uh time frame, somehow somebody cut the wires of that camera and pulled all of the duct tape off the pole.

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, a camera mounted on a pole was found with its wires cut and all the duct tape pulled off the pole, all in the short gap between two of its frames. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, citing a man named John B. Alexander: 'somehow somebody cut the wires of that camera and pulled all of the duct tape off the pole.' If true, something did the work faster than any person could have.
